headline: From the European peloton to your training plan
intro: I'm Mark Duroy. I grew up racing bikes in California's Central Valley, raced professionally in Belgium and the Netherlands, and have spent the thirty years since riding, racing and learning what actually makes cyclists faster.
photo_alt: Mark Duroy smiling on his bike
story:
I found cycling early and raced all through my teens. In the early '90s I went where the racing was hardest: the kermesses and classics of Belgium and the Netherlands. From 1992 to 1996 I raced for **Team Lada** in Belgium and **De Zwaluwen** in the Netherlands, in events like **Rund um Köln**, the **Ronde van Gelderland** and the **Ronde van Boxmeer**.

Those years taught me things no training app can: how to read a race, how to suffer smart, and how much of performance comes down to recovery, patience and consistency. Back then, coaches knew very little about recovery. I learned about overtraining the hard way, and I make sure my athletes don't have to.

After retiring at the end of 1996, I worked in the bike industry at **Specialized**, then came back to racing in 2001 and raced Cat 1/2/3 fields in Northern California until a training crash in 2015. Off the bike, I built a long career leading operations and supply-chain teams, which is where I learned to turn big goals into simple, repeatable systems.

In 2025 I founded Velo-Savvy to bring all of that together. Today I live in Austin with my wife Andrea and our dog Pablito, lead group rides, and coach riders of every age and discipline.
band_caption: Where it started: the cobbles, crosswinds and kermesses of Belgium and the Netherlands.

timeline.title: Junior racer in California
timeline.text: Started racing as a teenager in Northern California.

timeline.title: Professional racing in Europe
timeline.text: Raced for Team Lada (Belgium) and De Zwaluwen (Netherlands), including Rund um Köln, the Ronde van Gelderland, the Ronde van Boxmeer and the Baltic cycling championships.

timeline.title: Specialized
timeline.text: Moved into the bike industry at Specialized after retiring from pro racing.

timeline.title: Back to racing
timeline.text: Returned to racing in Northern California, including Cat 1/2/3 races like the Modesto Criterium and Modesto Road Race.

timeline.title: Founded Velo-Savvy
timeline.text: Started coaching full time in Austin, Texas, as a USA Cycling certified coach.

principles.title: Consistency beats heroics
principles.text: You don't get faster from one huge workout. You get faster from steady weeks, stacked up over a season.

principles.title: Recovery is training
principles.text: Sleep, food and easy days are where the fitness actually shows up. I plan them as carefully as the intervals.

principles.title: Know the why
principles.text: Every session has a purpose, and I'll explain it. Riders who understand their training make better decisions on the road.

principles.title: Race craft matters
principles.text: Positioning, pacing and patience win more races than watts alone. That's the part of coaching I enjoy most.
